subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add a Control UI/save-time workflow for bootstrap-file budgets, and which parts should core own: meter only, blocking saves, or auto-archive?
rationale: Current main already covers runtime diagnostics, but the remaining request affects Control UI UX and potentially moves user memory content, which is a product and ownership decision rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Scope narrow visibility and recovery
options.body: Add an active-workspace budget meter plus clear trim/doctor guidance first, and defer automatic archive moves until a separate design owns memory semantics.

options.title: Adopt diagnostics only
options.body: Review or replace the partial diagnostics PR for status/edit-error hints and leave Control UI save enforcement for later.

options.title: Defer UI/archive behavior
options.body: Keep the shipped prompt, doctor, and `/context` warnings as the supported path unless maintainers explicitly sponsor a richer workflow.

recommendation.title: Scope narrow visibility and recovery
recommendation.body: Add an active-workspace budget meter plus clear trim/doctor guidance first, and defer automatic archive moves until a separate design owns memory semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to bootstrap prompt behavior, config/docs, and doctor documentation, and the remaining question is product scope.
